name: Constant Folding
description: Evaluates constant expressions at compile time, such as replacing 2 * 3 with 6.

name: Constant Propagation
description: Replaces variables known to hold a constant value with that constant at their uses.

name: Copy Propagation
description: Replaces uses of a variable that was assigned from another variable with the original source.

name: Dead Code Elimination
description: Removes instructions whose results are never used and that have no side effects.

name: Dead Store Elimination
description: Removes stores to memory locations that are overwritten or never read before the end of their lifetime.

name: Common Subexpression Elimination
description: Reuses the result of an identical computation instead of recomputing it.

name: Global Value Numbering
description: Assigns value numbers to expressions across basic blocks to detect redundant computations.

name: Partial Redundancy Elimination
description: Removes computations that are redundant on some but not all execution paths.

name: Lazy Code Motion
description: Places partially redundant computations at the latest safe point to minimize register pressure.

name: Loop Invariant Code Motion
description: Moves computations whose operands do not change within a loop to the loop preheader.

name: Induction Variable Simplification
description: Rewrites expressions that depend on loop induction variables into cheaper forms.

name: Strength Reduction
description: Replaces expensive operations like multiplication with cheaper equivalents such as addition in loops.

name: Loop Unrolling
description: Replicates the loop body to reduce branch overhead and expose more instruction-level parallelism.

name: Loop Peeling
description: Extracts the first iteration of a loop so that its special cases can be simplified.

name: Loop Fusion
description: Combines adjacent loops with identical iteration spaces to improve data locality.

name: Loop Fission
description: Splits one loop into several to improve cache behavior or enable vectorization.

name: Loop Interchange
description: Swaps nested loop levels to improve memory access patterns.

name: Loop Tiling
description: Partitions loop iteration spaces into blocks that fit in cache.

name: Loop Unswitching
description: Moves a loop-invariant conditional outside the loop and duplicates the loop for each branch.

name: Loop Rotation
description: Converts a while-style loop into a do-while form with the test at the bottom.

name: Loop Deletion
description: Removes loops that have no observable effect.

name: Loop Idiom Recognition
description: Replaces loops that implement common patterns, such as memset or memcpy, with library or intrinsic calls.

name: Loop Vectorization
description: Transforms loops to operate on multiple data elements per instruction using SIMD.

name: Superword Level Parallelism
description: Packs independent scalar operations within a basic block into vector operations.

name: Loop Distribution
description: Splits a loop into independent loops to enable parallelization or vectorization.

name: Loop Reversal
description: Reverses iteration direction to simplify bounds checks or enable other transformations.

name: Loop Collapsing
description: Flattens a nested loop into a single loop over the combined iteration space.

name: Loop Strip Mining
description: Splits a loop into an outer loop over chunks and an inner loop over elements within each chunk.

name: Loop Versioning
description: Creates specialized loop copies for cases where runtime checks prove a fast path is safe.

name: Loop Software Pipelining
description: Overlaps iterations of a loop to hide instruction latency.

name: Inlining
description: Replaces a function call with the body of the called function.

name: Partial Inlining
description: Inlines only the frequently executed portion of a function.

name: Tail Call Optimization
description: Turns calls in tail position into jumps that reuse the current stack frame.

name: Tail Recursion Elimination
description: Converts self-recursive tail calls into loops.

name: Function Specialization
description: Creates copies of a function specialized for particular argument values.

name: Argument Promotion
description: Replaces pointer arguments with the scalar values they point to when safe.

name: Dead Argument Elimination
description: Removes function parameters that are never used.

name: Interprocedural Constant Propagation
description: Propagates constant arguments and return values across function boundaries.

name: Function Attribute Inference
description: Infers attributes such as pure, readonly, or nounwind from function bodies.

name: Global Dead Code Elimination
description: Removes functions and data that are unreachable from the program entry point.

name: Identical Code Folding
description: Merges functions with identical machine code into a single copy.

name: Whole Program Optimization
description: Performs optimizations across all translation units at link time.

name: Devirtualization
description: Replaces indirect or virtual calls with direct calls when the target is known.

name: Speculative Devirtualization
description: Guards a likely call target with a check and falls back to dynamic dispatch otherwise.

name: Escape Analysis
description: Determines whether objects are visible outside their creating scope to allow stack allocation.

name: Scalar Replacement of Aggregates
description: Breaks aggregate objects into independent scalar variables held in registers.

name: Stack Allocation of Objects
description: Allocates heap-candidate objects on the stack when escape analysis permits.

name: Heap-to-Stack Promotion
description: Converts heap allocations that never escape into stack allocations.

name: Allocation Sinking
description: Delays allocations until they are needed on the path where they are used.

name: Redundant Load Elimination
description: Reuses a previously loaded value when no intervening store may alias it.

name: Store-to-Load Forwarding
description: Replaces a load that follows a store to the same location with the stored value.

name: Memory to Register Promotion
description: Converts stack slots that are not address-taken into SSA values.

name: Alias Analysis
description: Determines which memory references may refer to the same location to enable other transformations.

name: Type-Based Alias Analysis
description: Uses declared types to conclude that accesses of incompatible types do not alias.

name: Scalar Evolution Analysis
description: Describes how scalar values change across loop iterations to support loop optimizations.

name: Range Analysis
description: Computes bounds on integer values to eliminate overflow checks and bounds checks.

name: Bounds Check Elimination
description: Removes array bounds checks that range or loop analysis proves redundant.

name: Null Check Elimination
description: Removes null pointer checks when a pointer is already known to be non-null.

name: Overflow Check Elimination
description: Removes integer overflow checks when range information proves they cannot fail.

name: Division by Constant Optimization
description: Replaces division by a constant with multiplication by a precomputed reciprocal and shifts.

name: Multiplication by Constant Optimization
description: Expresses multiplication by a constant as a sequence of shifts, adds, and subtracts.

name: Modulo by Power of Two
description: Replaces modulo by a power of two with a bitwise AND.

name: Algebraic Simplification
description: Applies identities such as x + 0 = x and x * 1 = x.

name: Reassociation
description: Reorders associative operations to expose constant folding or common subexpressions.

name: Distributive Law Application
description: Rewrites expressions using the distributive law when it reduces operation count.

name: Boolean Expression Simplification
description: Reduces boolean formulas using identities and tools such as Quine-McCluskey.

name: Peephole Optimization
description: Replaces short sequences of machine instructions with shorter or faster equivalents.

name: Instruction Combining
description: Merges multiple IR instructions into fewer, more efficient ones.

name: Select Optimization
description: Converts conditional selections into arithmetic or conditional moves where profitable.

name: If-Conversion
description: Replaces short conditional branches with predicated or conditional-move instructions.

name: Branch Elimination
description: Removes branches whose outcome is statically known.

name: Jump Threading
description: Redirects jumps past blocks whose outcome is determined by the predecessor.

name: Branch Prediction Hints
description: Emits likely and unlikely annotations so the layout favors the common path.

name: Block Layout Optimization
description: Orders basic blocks to reduce taken branches and improve instruction cache locality.

name: Hot-Cold Splitting
description: Moves rarely executed code into separate sections away from hot code.

name: Unreachable Block Elimination
description: Removes basic blocks that cannot be reached from the entry.

name: Control Flow Simplification
description: Merges trivial blocks and removes empty jumps.

name: Switch Lowering to Jump Tables
description: Implements dense switch statements with indexed jump tables.

name: Switch Lowering to Binary Search
description: Implements sparse switch statements with a balanced comparison tree.

name: Switch to Lookup Table
description: Replaces a switch whose cases compute values with a constant table lookup.

name: Short-Circuit Evaluation Optimization
description: Reorders or simplifies logical operator evaluation to reduce branches.

name: Register Allocation by Graph Coloring
description: Assigns variables to physical registers by coloring an interference graph.

name: Linear Scan Register Allocation
description: Allocates registers in a single pass over live intervals for fast compilation.

name: Register Coalescing
description: Merges move-related virtual registers to remove unnecessary copies.

name: Rematerialization
description: Recomputes cheap values instead of spilling and reloading them.

name: Spill Code Optimization
description: Reduces the cost of spills by placing stores and loads at better points.

name: Shrink Wrapping
description: Delays prologue and epilogue code until it is needed on a given path.

name: Frame Pointer Omission
description: Frees the frame pointer register for general use when debugging needs allow.

name: Instruction Scheduling
description: Reorders instructions to hide latency and avoid pipeline stalls.

name: Trace Scheduling
description: Schedules instructions along the most frequently executed traces.

name: Superblock Formation
description: Forms single-entry, multi-exit regions to enlarge scheduling scope.

name: Hyperblock Formation
description: Combines paths into a predicated region to expose parallelism.

name: Tail Duplication
description: Copies small tail blocks into predecessors to remove jumps and expose optimization.

name: Instruction Selection by Tree Pattern Matching
description: Maps IR trees to machine instructions using dynamic programming over patterns.

name: Addressing Mode Optimization
description: Folds address arithmetic into the addressing modes of load and store instructions.

name: Load-Store Pairing
description: Combines adjacent loads or stores into wider paired operations.

name: Load Hoisting
description: Moves loads earlier to hide memory latency when safe.

name: Prefetch Insertion
description: Inserts prefetch instructions ahead of predictable memory accesses.

name: Software Prefetching Distance Tuning
description: Chooses how far ahead to prefetch based on memory latency estimates.

name: Cache Blocking
description: Restructures computation so that working sets fit within cache levels.

name: Data Layout Optimization
description: Reorders struct fields or array layouts to improve locality and reduce padding.

name: Structure Splitting
description: Separates hot and cold fields of a structure into different arrays.

name: Array of Structures to Structure of Arrays
description: Transforms the layout of records into separate per-field arrays for vectorization.

name: False Sharing Elimination
description: Pads or realigns shared data so that independent threads do not contend on one cache line.

name: Lock Elision
description: Removes locks that are provably unnecessary or executes critical sections speculatively.

name: Lock Coarsening
description: Merges adjacent acquisitions of the same lock into a single critical section.

name: Atomic Operation Relaxation
description: Weakens memory ordering constraints where the surrounding code allows it.

name: Parallelization
description: Automatically distributes loop iterations or independent tasks across threads.

name: Auto-Vectorization of Reductions
description: Vectorizes reduction loops by keeping partial sums in vector registers.

name: Predicated Vectorization
description: Uses masks to vectorize loops containing conditional statements.

name: Vector Shuffle Optimization
description: Chooses efficient shuffle sequences to rearrange vector lanes.

name: Gather and Scatter Optimization
description: Uses hardware gather and scatter only when the access pattern benefits from them.

name: Fused Multiply-Add Formation
description: Combines separate multiply and add operations into a single FMA instruction.

name: Floating-Point Reassociation
description: Reorders floating-point operations under fast-math rules to expose optimization.

name: Reciprocal Approximation
description: Uses fast approximate reciprocal and square root instructions with refinement steps.

name: Integer Division Strength Reduction
description: Replaces integer division with multiplication when the divisor is a known constant.

name: Bit Test Optimization
description: Combines multiple bit tests into a single mask comparison.

name: Popcount and Bit Scan Intrinsics
description: Recognizes bit-counting loops and replaces them with hardware instructions.

name: Comparison Chain Simplification
description: Simplifies chained comparisons into fewer tests using ordering facts.

name: Sign Extension Elimination
description: Removes sign or zero extensions whose results are never observed in wider form.

name: Narrowing Integer Operations
description: Performs operations at a narrower width when the high bits are provably unused.

name: Shift Combining
description: Merges consecutive shift operations into a single shift when the amounts combine.

name: Mask Combining
description: Merges consecutive AND or OR masks into one equivalent mask.

name: Branchless Min and Max
description: Computes minimum and maximum without branches using conditional moves or arithmetic.

name: Branchless Absolute Value
description: Computes absolute values using sign-mask arithmetic instead of branches.

name: String Operation Inlining
description: Expands small fixed-size string operations inline rather than calling library routines.

name: Memcpy and Memset Inlining
description: Replaces small constant-size memory copy and fill calls with direct loads and stores.

name: Builtin Recognition
description: Identifies calls to standard library functions and substitutes faster equivalents.

name: printf to puts Conversion
description: Rewrites printf calls with constant format strings that need no conversions into puts or putchar.

name: Math Library Specialization
description: Replaces math library calls with intrinsics or simplified forms for special arguments.

name: Exception Handling Table Compression
description: Shrinks unwind tables by merging identical entries and using compact encodings.

name: Exception Check Elimination
description: Removes exception handling edges for calls that are proven not to throw.

name: Zero-Cost Exception Dispatch
description: Arranges exception handling so the normal path incurs no runtime overhead.

name: Virtual Call Table Compaction
description: Reduces the size of virtual dispatch tables by sharing identical entries.

name: Inline Cache
description: Caches the most recent dispatch target at each call site to speed repeated calls.

name: Polymorphic Inline Cache
description: Extends inline caches to hold several receiver types at one call site.

name: Type Feedback Collection
description: Records observed types at runtime to guide later optimization.

name: Just-In-Time Specialization
description: Generates code specialized to the types and values observed during execution.

name: On-Stack Replacement
description: Swaps a running interpreted or baseline frame for optimized code mid-execution.

name: Deoptimization
description: Falls back from optimized code to a safe version when speculative assumptions fail.

name: Method Splitting
description: Separates rarely used paths of a method so the hot path can be optimized independently.

name: Class Hierarchy Analysis
description: Uses the class hierarchy to determine possible targets of virtual calls.

name: Final Method Inference
description: Treats methods with no overriding implementations as final to allow direct calls.

name: Field Load Hoisting for Immutable Fields
description: Caches values from final or immutable fields since they cannot change after construction.

name: Write Barrier Elimination
description: Removes garbage collector write barriers when the stored value does not require tracking.

name: Allocation Merging
description: Combines several small allocations into one larger allocation.

name: Object Header Elimination
description: Omits headers for objects whose type is known statically and never needs runtime identification.

name: Boxing Elimination
description: Removes temporary boxes around primitive values that are immediately unboxed.

name: Unboxing Specialization
description: Passes and returns primitive values directly instead of wrapped objects where types allow.

name: String Concatenation Optimization
description: Combines chained string concatenations into a single buffer operation.

name: String Interning
description: Stores equal string literals once so that they can be compared by reference.

name: Constant Table Deduplication
description: Merges identical constant data such as literal strings across translation units.

name: Read-Only Data Placement
description: Places constants in read-only sections to share pages and reduce memory use.

name: Section Garbage Collection
description: Discards unused sections of object files during linking.

name: Function Ordering for Locality
description: Arranges functions in the binary according to their call order to reduce page faults.

name: Profile-Guided Optimization
description: Uses execution profiles collected from training runs to guide inlining, layout, and branch decisions.

name: Sample-Based Profiling Feedback
description: Uses sampled hardware event data to guide optimization without instrumented builds.

name: Basic Block Profiling
description: Counts how often each basic block executes to inform layout and scheduling.

name: Value Profiling
description: Records frequently occurring values at specific sites to enable specialization.

name: Link-Time Optimization
description: Performs optimizations on the whole program at link time using intermediate representations.

name: Link-Time Code Generation
description: Generates final machine code at link time after cross-module analysis.

name: Binary Layout Optimization
description: Rewrites the final binary to place hot code together, often using measured profiles.

name: Binary Instrumentation Removal
description: Strips profiling or sanitizer hooks from release binaries.

name: Code Alignment
description: Aligns loop headers and branch targets to fetch-friendly boundaries.

name: Macro-Op Fusion Awareness
description: Orders compare and branch instructions so that the processor can fuse them.

name: Microarchitecture-Aware Scheduling
description: Schedules instructions using a model of execution ports and latencies for a target CPU.

name: Cold Code Size Reduction
description: Uses compact encodings and shared stubs for rarely executed code.

name: Code Size Optimization
description: Prefers shorter instruction encodings and smaller inlining budgets when size matters.

name: Function Merging
description: Combines functions that are similar but not identical into one parameterized function.

name: Constant Hoisting
description: Materializes expensive constants once and reuses them across the function.

name: Rotate and Shift Pattern Recognition
description: Recognizes shift-and-or sequences as rotate instructions.

name: Byte Swap Recognition
description: Recognizes manual byte-reversal code and emits a single byte-swap instruction.

name: Dead Exception Path Elimination
description: Removes exception handlers that can never be reached given the surrounding code.

name: Redundant Null Pointer Propagation
description: Carries null-check results to later uses of the same pointer on dominated paths.

name: Loop Exit Value Replacement
description: Computes the value of a variable after a loop directly, avoiding the loop when possible.

name: Hot Loop Alignment
description: Pads hot loops so their bodies fit within a single fetch or cache line.

name: Reduction to Closed Form
description: Replaces summation or product loops over arithmetic sequences with closed-form expressions.

name: Memory Operation Merging
description: Merges adjacent narrow stores of constants into a single wider store.

name: Sinking Common Code
description: Moves identical instructions from all predecessors of a block into the block itself.

name: Hoisting Common Code
description: Moves identical instructions from all successors of a branch up to the branch point.
